mapper.sql: task_id, requester_user_id, task_type, agent_id, session_id, skill_id, skill_version, idempotency_key, request_sha256, input_snapshot::text AS input_snapshot, status, progress, attempt_count, max_attempts, dispatch_attempt_count, error_summary, failure_type, result_json::text AS result_json, result_reference, next_attempt_at, last_dispatched_at, lease_expires_at, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO builtin_skill_execution_task ( task_id, requester_user_id, task_type, agent_id, session_id, skill_id, skill_version, idempotency_key, request_sha256, input_snapshot, status, progress, attempt_count, max_attempts, result_reference ) VALUES ( CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid), #{requesterUserId}, #{taskType}, CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid), CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid), #{skillId}, #{skillVersion}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestSha256}, CAST(#{inputSnapshot} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{progress}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{resultReference} ) ON CONFLICT (requester_user_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM builtin_skill_execution_task WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND requester_user_id = #{requesterUserId}
SELECT FROM builtin_skill_execution_task WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid)

SELECT task_id::text FROM builtin_skill_execution_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, task_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET dispatch_attempt_count = dispatch_attempt_count + 1, last_dispatched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET status = 'RUNNING', progress = 5, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), lease_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), error_summary = NULL, failure_type = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', progress = 100, result_json = CAST(#{resultJson} AS jsonb), error_summary = NULL, failure_type = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}

UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET status = 'RETRYING', failure_type = #{failureType}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{retryDelaySeconds}), lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND attempt_count < max_attempts

UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET status = 'DEAD_LETTER', failure_type = #{failureType}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND attempt_count >= max_attempts

UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_type = #{failureType}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}

UPDATE builtin_skill_execution_task SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN 'DEAD_LETTER' ELSE 'RETRYING' END, failure_type = 'ExecutionLeaseExpired', error_summary = 'Skill 执行租约超时', next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{retryDelaySeconds}), lease_expires_at = NULL, completed_at = CASE WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
